messages:
Rae: serious (but also silly) question: what's your most embarrassing comfort movie? guilty pleasures welcome.
Tom: Anchorman. I will fight you about Ron Burgundy.
Isha: Legally Blonde. pink blazer forever.
Diego: any rom-com with rain scenes + dramatic umbrella. no exceptions.
Nina: The Princess Diaries. it9s a mood.
Tom: @Diego same. also that one scene in Notting Hill where books happen.
Rae: haha love this. @beebot, add 'Comfort Movie Night' poll? :popcorn:
beebot: Poll created: "Comfort Movie Night" with options: Anchorman, Legally Blonde, Notting Hill, The Princess Diaries, Other. Voting open for 24h.
Isha: also shoutout to anyone who picks an animated movie — the vibes are immaculate.
Diego: voting now. low-stakes but high emotional return.
Nina: movie night when this week? good excuse for snacks.
Rae: vote results and snack sign-up tomorrow :tada:
